Hi Laura —

Quick one: we’re about 70% through our internal integration checklist but a few downstream teams hit blockers, so our consumption for the pilot has been lighter than expected. The current pilot end date is May 10 and we’d like to avoid an abrupt cutoff while we finish validation.

Would Redwood consider a short, 2–3 week extension with a burn-smoothing approach rather than a straight pro-rata top-up? Concretely, we’re hoping for either:
- Option A: 3-week extension + a modest discount on incremental tokens for that window, OR
- Option B: 2-week extension + a small burst bucket (fixed token allowance) we can use in week 1 if traffic spikes.

We’re happy to sign a one-page addendum. Procurement and I would also need any simple invoice language for finance. Can you share what’s feasible by EOW May 4?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Reynolds
Head of ML Engineering, Solstice AI

Jordan —

Appreciate the heads-up and the clear options. We can do either path; tradeoffs below so you can pick what works operationally:

Option 1 (conservative): 3-week extension, 20% discount on incremental tokens consumed during the extension window. No change to SLA. Good if you want runway to finish validation without complexity.

Option 2 (burst-friendly): 2-week extension, no percentage discount, but a one-time burst bucket of 30k tokens usable in the first 7 days. Any usage beyond the burst is billed at standard pilot rates. We’d cap total incremental spend to avoid surprise invoices.

One more hybrid we sometimes use: 2-week extension + 15% discount + 15k token burst (split across week 1). If Procurement wants simpler invoicing we can surface a one-line addendum and a DocuSign link.

I’ve attached a one-page amendment draft reflecting Option 1 and the hybrid (clean copy for review). If you want to move forward with the burst approach we’ll need a sign-off from Finance for the capped burst. Please let me know which you prefer by COB May 4 and I’ll route the addendum.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Team —

Solstice (deal SOL-2028-09) asked for a short extension and suggested two flavors (3w w/ discount OR 2w + burst). They’re a mid-market prospect but strategic for our cataloging use-case. Current pilot ends 2028-05-10.

Key considerations:
- Margin: this customer is price-sensitive; a 20% token discount for 3 weeks is material but keeps simplicity.
- Precedent: we’ve done burst buckets in a few pilots (see Jonas’ notes) but they can be awkward to invoice.
- Eng support: Marissa, will CS commit to triage during the extended window if we give burst capacity?

Suggested stance: Offer hybrid: 2-week extension + 15% discount + 15k token burst (week 1 only) capped. Finance to approve revenue impact, and require DocuSign addendum + PO or consolidated invoice.

Can you weigh in today? Jordan needs options by EOW May 4.

—Laura

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Internal: Solstice ask — grace window / burst bucket approval

Laurel + team —

Numbers quick: expected incremental revenue for each option (ballpark)
- Option 1 (3w, 20% off incremental): ~$18k ARR-equivalent impact (low one-off; acceptable but leans conservative).
- Option 2 (2w + 30k burst): higher exposure if burst used — expected collectable ~$9k but risk if they fully consume; requires invoice cadence.
- Hybrid (2w, 15% + 15k burst): compromise; expected net ~$11k exposure.

Recommendation: Approve the hybrid (2w, 15% discount + 15k burst) with these guardrails: burst only valid in week 1, burst token usage reported in the consolidated invoice, PO or charged to CC on file within 7 days of addendum signature, and a hard cap of $25k incremental value. That keeps commercial flexibility and limits revenue exposure.

Marissa — can CS commit to priority triage for canonical issues during the extension window if we go hybrid?

—David
Finance, Redwood Inference

Jordan / Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We spoke with Finance and CS; Redwood can proceed with the hybrid approach:

Summary of agreed terms (draft addendum attached):
- Extension: 2 weeks (pilot end moves from 2028-05-10 to 2028-05-24)
- Discount: 15% off incremental token consumption during the extension window only
- Burst: 15,000 token burst available in week 1 (usable any time during first 7 days); any burst overage billed at standard pilot rates
- Cap: total incremental value capped at $25,000 for the amendment period
- Support: Marissa’s team will provide priority triage for high-severity issues during the extension; details in addendum
- Billing: DocuSign addendum + PO or invoice to be issued. Please sign the addendum by 2028-05-06 to guarantee burst allocation.

I’ve attached the one-page addendum and a usage snapshot we pulled. If that looks good, I’ll send the DocuSign link (or Elena’s procurement can upload a PO and we’ll attach it).

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the terms (reply OK)
2) Sign addendum via DocuSign link I’ll send after you reply OK
3) If signing via PO, please share the PO number and billing contact so Finance can finalize the invoice.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the language.

Best,
